conclusion: A successful Windows full CMake install overlays resources and does not ensure the installed profile file set equals current source. A verified install from bc4d9aa5de retained 1685 pre-existing extra files; all current-source files were already present and byte-identical. Archive and hash-verify extra output files before reconciling, preserve unknown provenance, and recheck exact output/source file sets. The Inlong-only target recreates its directory and had 734 matching profile-related files; the reconciled full output had 14756. Preserve portable settings before both targets and verify exact restoration afterward. These are local install checks, not Provider release readiness.
scope: Default Windows full and Inlong-only CMake installation outputs
